newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia opposition tells gov't to resign on NATO.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia opposition tells gov't to resign on NATO.

text.p: Slovenia's opposition Christian Democrats called on Wednesday for the resignation of the foreign minister and the government to atone for the country's failed bid for NATO membership.

Christian Democrat president Lojze Peterle told national radio that failure to join the western military alliance in its first eastward expansion was: "a big failure of Slovenia's internal and external policy and the governing coalition."
"This calls for the replacement of the inefficient government, but first the foreign minister must step down," Peterle said.
The Christian Democrats hold nine out of 90 parliamentary seats.
On Tuesday, Poland, Hungary and the Czech Republic were invited to join the 16-member alliance, but held out the prospect of further expansion.
